env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

# Six fields nested five deep expands 6^5 copies. The incremental
# budget must trip before the product materializes.
cd wnest
! logos build ./...
stderr 'comptime::node_limit'
cd ..

# SPEC 2.5 [T-205]: an expansion above max_comptime_ast_nodes fails with
# [comptime::node_limit]. The trip is incremental: six fields nested
# twelve deep would expand to 6^12 copies, so a build that charges the
# budget only after the whole expansion cannot finish. The helper runs
# that rejected build against the wall time of an accepted build of a
# small nest, kills a run that outlasts ten times that time or ten
# seconds, whichever is larger, and passes when any of three attempts
# finishes inside the bound with the node-limit rule. Each trial appends
# a comment so no cached answer stands in for a build.
[!GOOS:windows] exec go run timer.go wok wover
[!GOOS:windows] stdout 'incremental ok'

-- wnest/go.mod --
module example.com/nestedlimit

go 1.27

-- wnest/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"comptime"
	"fmt"
)

type S struct {
	F0 int
	F1 int
	F2 int
	F3 int
	F4 int
	F5 int
}

func show(v S) int {
	n := 0
	const for _, f0 := range comptime.Fields[S]() {
		const for _, f1 := range comptime.Fields[S]() {
			const for _, f2 := range comptime.Fields[S]() {
				const for _, f3 := range comptime.Fields[S]() {
					const for _, f4 := range comptime.Fields[S]() {
						n += v.[f0] + v.[f1] + v.[f2] + v.[f3] + v.[f4]
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
	return n
}

func main() {
	fmt.Println(show(S{}))
}

-- timer.go --
package main

import (
	"context"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"os/exec"
	"strings"
	"syscall"
	"time"
)

func build(dir string, trial int, limit time.Duration) (time.Duration, string, error, bool) {
	p := dir + "/lib.lgo"
	b, err := os.ReadFile(p)
	if err != nil {
		fmt.Println("read:", err)
		os.Exit(1)
	}
	if err := os.WriteFile(p, append(b, fmt.Sprintf("\n// trial %d\n", trial)...), 0666); err != nil {
		fmt.Println("write:", err)
		os.Exit(1)
	}
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), limit)
	defer cancel()
	cmd := exec.CommandContext(ctx, "logos", "build", "./...")
	cmd.Dir = dir
	cmd.SysProcAttr = &syscall.SysProcAttr{Setpgid: true}
	cmd.Cancel = func() error { return syscall.Kill(-cmd.Process.Pid, syscall.SIGKILL) }
	start := time.Now()
	out, err := cmd.CombinedOutput()
	return time.Since(start), string(out), err, ctx.Err() != nil
}

func accepted(dir string) time.Duration {
	best := time.Duration(1 << 62)
	for i := 0; i < 3; i++ {
		d, out, err, _ := build(dir, i, time.Minute)
		if err != nil {
			fmt.Printf("under-limit build failed: %v\n%.300s\n", err, out)
			os.Exit(1)
		}
		best = min(best, d)
	}
	return best
}

func main() {
	acc := accepted(os.Args[1])
	bound := max(10*acc, 10*time.Second)
	for i := 0; i < 3; i++ {
		d, out, err, timedOut := build(os.Args[2], i, bound)
		if timedOut {
			continue
		}
		if err == nil || !strings.Contains(out, "comptime::node_limit") {
			fmt.Printf("over-limit build did not fail with comptime::node_limit: err=%v\n%.300s\n", err, out)
			os.Exit(1)
		}
		fmt.Println("incremental ok", d, "accepted", acc)
		return
	}
	fmt.Printf("incremental violated: over-limit build outlasted %v, accepted build took %v\n", bound, acc)
	os.Exit(1)
}

-- wok/go.mod --
module example.com/wok

go 1.27

-- wok/lib.lgo --
package wok

import "comptime"

type S struct {
	F0 int
	F1 int
	F2 int
	F3 int
	F4 int
	F5 int
}

func Sum(v S) int {
	n := 0
	const for _, f0 := range comptime.Fields[S]() {
		const for _, f1 := range comptime.Fields[S]() {
			n += v.[f0] + v.[f1]
		}
	}
	return n
}

-- wover/go.mod --
module example.com/wover

go 1.27

-- wover/lib.lgo --
package wover

import "comptime"

type S struct {
	F0 int
	F1 int
	F2 int
	F3 int
	F4 int
	F5 int
}

func Sum(v S) int {
	n := 0
	const for _, f0 := range comptime.Fields[S]() {
		const for _, f1 := range comptime.Fields[S]() {
			const for _, f2 := range comptime.Fields[S]() {
				const for _, f3 := range comptime.Fields[S]() {
					const for _, f4 := range comptime.Fields[S]() {
						const for _, f5 := range comptime.Fields[S]() {
							const for _, f6 := range comptime.Fields[S]() {
								const for _, f7 := range comptime.Fields[S]() {
									const for _, f8 := range comptime.Fields[S]() {
										const for _, f9 := range comptime.Fields[S]() {
											const for _, f10 := range comptime.Fields[S]() {
												const for _, f11 := range comptime.Fields[S]() {
													n += v.[f0] + v.[f1] + v.[f2] + v.[f3] + v.[f4] + v.[f5] + v.[f6] + v.[f7] + v.[f8] + v.[f9] + v.[f10] + v.[f11]
												}
											}
										}
									}
								}
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
	return n
}
